title: personas.json — roles → accounts → env-var NAMES (never values)
description: See docs/DESIGN-ROLES-ACCOUNTS.md. The authoritative validator is src/personas/schema.ts; this file gives editors completions and hover help.

instanceUrlEnv.description: Env NAME holding the org's My Domain URL (SF_INSTANCE_URL).

sites.description: Experience Cloud sites / other systems a persona may live on, keyed by site id.

accounts.description: Logins, one per real user in an application. Env names are DERIVED from the id: <PREFIX>_<ACCOUNT>_USERNAME/_PASSWORD/_TOKEN/_TOTP_SECRET (SF for salesforce).

system.description: Application the login belongs to — salesforce (default), siebel, …

poolSize.description: Clone logins for parallel workers, read from …_W0…_W(N-1).

usernameEnv.description: Override of the derived name (legacy .env vocabulary).

personas.description: Roles as the test cases name them, each bound to the account it logs in as.

role.description: The role as the test cases name it, e.g. "Client Lead".

account.description: A declared account this role logs in as. Roles may share one.

usernameEnv.description: LEGACY self-wired persona (no account). Do not write new ones.

envName.description: An env-var NAME. Never a value.

envNameOrOff.description: An env-var NAME, or "" meaning this login does not use it.
